raw_evidence:
Add runtime enforcement in `bin/modonome.mjs`:

1. Before executing any command that reads `autonomy_enabled` from config, check for
   the `MODONOME_ARMED=true` environment variable. If absent, override
   `autonomy_enabled` to `false` regardless of what `config.yaml` says, and emit a
   clear warning: `[modonome] MODONOME_ARMED not set; running in dry-run mode.`
normalized_decision: Add runtime check in bin/modonome.mjs: before reading autonomy_enabled from config, check MODONOME_ARMED=true; if absent, override autonomy_enabled to false and emit warning — config file alone can never arm the engine
candidate_rule: Runtime check in bin/modonome.mjs overrides autonomy_enabled to false unless MODONOME_ARMED=true is set; config file alone cannot arm the engine
human_notes: Approved candidate boundary. Source: ADR-004 lines 23-28. Code-level enforcement replacing prompt convention. deployment_infrastructure domain removed (source supports security_privacy only). allocate_ownership purpose removed. effective_date=null.
